title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final answer for the time tau when the radius is R/2.

title: Energy Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly derives the total energy equation for the particle in circular motion.

title: Radiation Loss
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies and applies the formula for energy loss due to radiation.

title: Differential Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student sets up and solves the differential equation relating dr/dt to energy loss.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly sets up the integral to find the time tau from R to R/2.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to correctly handle the signs in the differential equation or integral limits.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student discusses limiting cases or assumptions made during the derivation.
